# Hero

Background photograph for the homepage hero.

- `hero.jpg` — a UNC Chapel Hill campus photo, landscape orientation, at least 2400px wide.
- Rendered `cover` / center under an 80%-opacity navy (#233265) overlay, so favour a photo with an open, uncluttered centre; fine detail will not read through the scrim.
- Keep it under ~500KB if possible — it is the first paint.
- If the file is absent the hero falls back to solid navy; nothing breaks.

Filename must be exactly `hero.jpg`.
